verdict.rationale: Apify documents scheduled background runs: Actors and saved tasks start automatically at set times, saved tasks rerun with stored inputs, and webhooks trigger follow-up Actors or HTTP actions when a run finishes or fails. Monitoring with alerts supports unattended operation. Missing for 10: in-depth schedule and cron documentation beyond one-line mentions, independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous background runs, and evidence that AI agents (e.g., via MCP) can set up these recurring automations themselves.
